answer: Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the yarrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short.
